 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marks = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(marks) < 2:
        return out
    marks.sort()
    dr = marks[1][0] - marks[0][0]
    dc = marks[1][1] - marks[0][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0:
        return out
    # Continue the repeated diagonal spacing, marking the new positions in 2.
    r, c = marks[-1]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    while r + dr < h and c + dc < w:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
"
